name: How much does shower installation cost in Denver-area homes?

mainEntity.name: How much does shower installation cost in Denver-area homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary based on whether you choose a basic prefabricated shower, a tile shower, or a custom walk-in or curbless design. In the Denver area, walk-in shower projects can range widely, so the final price depends on demolition, waterproofing, plumbing, tile, and glass choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price depends on the shower type, plumbing, waterproofing, tile, and glass. Custom or walk-in designs cost more than a basic replacement.
